answer: A farm can mint a thousand vertices in an afternoon, wire them together, an orchard of a hundred trunks on one root, still one tree. Pay for bridges instead, the links each vertex holds outside its own cluster. Relays recount every vertex's bridges each epoch, and pay follows that count. A genuine bridge takes weeks of honest dealings to earn; one caught fake cuts every bridge its cluster touched. The honest price is a slow start, since a newcomer begins with none.
